slides.headline: Which Coach actually survives a semester?

slides.body: They pull in different directions. One is about the leather. The other is about resale.

slides.headline: Here, secondhand wins
slides.body: A real vintage or Tabby picked up under retail tends to keep more of what you paid than a brand-new tote that's everywhere this fall.
